compile_wizard_of_internet_results: run compile_results.py with --task-name and --output-folder to compile Wizard of Internet crowdsourcing task data into a JSON dataset
format_chat_data: use WizardOfInternetResultsCompiler.format_chat_data to parse dialog history messages into structured chat data with apprentice persona and dialog history
compile_chat_message: use ChatMessage to compile a single message dict into action, text, and context fields for Wizard of Internet dialog data
check_chat_interruption: use chat_interruption to detect if a message contains requested_finish or MEPHISTO_is_submit flags indicating task completion
check_persona_form_response: use is_persona_form_response to detect if a message contains task_data with form_responses for persona identification
